text:
lina: heads-up: mobile sampleapp crash observed when switching from LTE -> WiFi mid-stream. parser receives overlapping fragments and ends up with two JSON objects concatenated, causing parse failure.

omar: saw same on Android - packet reordering after TCP re-establish. stacktrace points to JSON.parse on partial payload.

kevin: can you paste a snippet of the raw chunks?

lina: raw: 
```
chunkA: "{"id":"r1","choices":["a"]}
chunkB: "{"id":"r1","choices":["b"]}
```

tara: interesting. looks like duplicate emission for same id plus out-of-order arrival. JS SDK tries to parse each chunk independently which makes it brittle. Go SDK buffers more aggressively.

omar: repro: start long stream in sampleapp, toggle airplane mode off/on, wait for automatic network reconnect. ~60% repro rate in our lab.

kevin: proposed fixes: 1) server can emit an explicit `id:` SSE field (integer seq) to let clients dedupe/reorder, behind an opt-in header so old clients keep working; 2) make JS parser buffer partial payloads until a safe parse boundary (balanced braces or delimiter).

lina: opt-in header sounds safe. maybe `X-Stream-Opts: seq=1` so clients can request seqs. server adds seq and checksum.

tara: sampleapp UX: show a small warning when we detect reorder/duplicate and attempt automatic merge/reparse. give users a manual retry button.

kevin: i'll implement buffered parser change in js-sdk: append chunks to a buffer, only attempt JSON.parse when braces balanced or we detect a complete SSE `data:` block. add tests for duplicate sequences and reordered chunks.

omar: i'll add an e2e that uses `tc qdisc` to simulate packet loss and `iptables` to cut the socket mid-stream to mimic TLS session re-init.

devops-bot: created ticket DEVEX-2392: stream-reorder-and-duplication, assigned to kevin and omar.

kevin: opened draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-js-sdk/pull/1503 with buffered parser + unit tests.

lina: telemetry please: `stream_reorder_detected` with fields `client_os`, `seq_enabled`, `gap_ms`, `duplicate_count`. non-PII only.

tara: agree, metric will help gauge impact. also plan staged rollout: sampleapp + sdk patch to staging, enable seq header for 5% mobile traffic behind feature flag.

omar: note: TLS session resume sometimes creates a new TCP socket while the app-level stream continues; server may re-emit the same logical events. server-side dedupe could help too.

kevin: added telemetry to PR and a small integration harness that reorders chunks and asserts successful parse. will add docs entry on `X-Stream-Opts: seq=1` for devex.

devops-bot: PR #1503 CI passed and merged. staging canary scheduled; enabling seq header for 5% at 2026-04-05T09:00:00Z.

lina: rolled the canary. early metrics show reorder events down from 0.9% -> 0.08% on mobile. will expand to 25% next week.

tara: updated sampleapp UI with manual resume and warning. adding short blurb in onboarding guide about network handoffs and recommended `X-Stream-Opts`.

kevin: closing loop: parser change + seq header + sampleapp UX reduced crashes in our tests. will monitor telemetry and open follow-up if TLS session-resume edgecases persist.
